`--strip_components`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Strip this amount of leading components from file names on extraction. For example, to extract only 'myfile.txt' from an archive containing the structure `this/goes/deep/myfile.txt', use 3 to strip 'this/goes/deep/'.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Example]{.arg-key} `1`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--exclude`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Prevents any file or member whose name matches the shell wildcard (pattern) from being extracted.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"docs/figures"`

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/compression/tar_extract/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline/v4.2.0/components/compression/tar_extract);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/compression/tar_extract/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
